summary: Collector of the Port of New York 1820–29, president of the Bank of the Manhattan Company; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed via Thompson and 4th cousin 7x removed via Bull Smith.
bio:
Path: John Thompson → Samuel → Jonathan → Isaac → Jonathan. His mother Mary Gardiner was a daughter of Col. Abraham & Mary (Smith) Gardiner.

3rd cousin 8 times removed via John Thompson and 4th cousin 7 times removed via Bull Smith through his mother Mary Gardiner (Bull -> Richard 2d -> Nathaniel -> Mary Smith -> Mary Gardiner -> Jonathan) ([R4-S1]). Children: David, George W., Jonathan, Dr. Abraham Gardiner, Mary (wife of Samuel Buel Gardiner, 10th Lord of Gardiner's Island) and Elizabeth.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 470 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
